```yaml
name: Draft Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      new_version:
        description: 'New version (e.g., 1.2.3)'
        required: false
      model:
        description: 'Model abbreviation (codex, glm, kimi)'
        required: false

jobs:
  draft:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Verify actor
        if: ${{ github.actor != 'dyoshikawa' && github.actor != 'cm-dyoshikawa' }}
        run: |
          echo "Unauthorized actor: ${{ github.actor }}"
          exit 1

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Resolve model abbreviation
        id: resolve_model
        uses: ./.github/actions/select-opencode-model
        with:
          input-text: ${{ inputs.model }}

      - name: Determine new version
        id: determine_version
        run: |
          if [[ -n "${{ inputs.new_version }}" ]]; then
            echo "new_version=${{ inputs.new_version }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            # Get current version from melos
            npx melos version --no-commit --no-push | grep -oP '(?<=v)[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' > /tmp/current_version
            current=$(cat /tmp/current_version)
            IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$current"
            patch=$((patch+1))
            new_ver="$major.$minor.$patch"
            echo "new_version=$new_ver" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create release branch
        run: |
          git checkout -b release/v${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}
          git push origin release/v${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}

      - name: Create pull request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          title: "Release ${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}"
          body: |
            Automated release PR for version ${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}
            Model: ${{ steps.resolve_model.outputs.cleaned-text }}
          base: main
          head: release/v${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}
          draft: false

      - name: Create draft release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: release/v${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}
          name: Release ${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          body: |
            Draft release for version ${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.new_version }}
            Model: ${{ steps.resolve_model.outputs.cleaned-text }}
```
